title: Advanced Tech Features
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly discuss the G70's advanced in-car technology, with clear praise for how impressive it feels and a smaller set of comments that only note its abundance or complexity without a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the technology as excellent, amazing, impressive, and among the best owners have experienced.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says the technology can feel complicated to use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention the amount, advanced feel, or overwhelming nature of the technology without enough context to confirm clear praise or criticism.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short and many are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence about specific technology features being discussed.
The topic is broad and often refers only to 'tech' in general rather than naming concrete systems or functions.
Examples are insufficient to determine whether comments about technology being advanced, abundant, or overwhelming reflect satisfaction, frustration, or simple observation in every case.
